entries.description: Answers consumer questions about money owed (deposits, refunds, denied claims) with primary-sourced facts and points to self-help kits.

tools.name: answer_money_question
tools.description: Look up verified, source-cited facts and a linked educational resource for a consumer money-recovery question (security deposits, denied refunds, denied insurance/warranty claims, unclaimed property). Read-only lookup: it does not collect personal data, make payments, or change anything.

question.description: The consumer's question in plain language, e.g. 'my landlord kept my security deposit'
